title: Fetch API and JSON
description: Distinguish HTTP error responses, rejected fetch promises, malformed JSON and user cancellation with a deterministic local transport demonstration.
objectives: Distinguish transport failures from HTTP response errors
Catch malformed JSON without misleading success messages
Abort an in-flight operation and announce cancellation
rubric: I verified HTTP 503 is not confused with a network failure.
I observed a JSON parse failure and a cancellation outcome.
I confirmed that every response is simulated locally without real network traffic.
